attempts.summary: Configured split-DNS authority: node1 (VyOS) answers app.internal -> node3's address (10.60.0.10) for lan-a clients via pdns_recursor + static-host-mapping on eth2 (10.60.0.1/24); node2 (OPNsense) answers app.internal -> node4's address (10.61.0.10) for lan-b clients via Unbound host-override on newly assigned opt1/vtnet2 interface (10.61.0.1/24) with a matching pass rule. Discovered topology via ARP/ICMP tcpdump probing (node1 eth2 <-> node3, node1 eth1 <-> node2 vtnet1 transit, node2 vtnet2 <-> node4), assigned static lan-a/lan-b addressing to node3/node4 via NetworkManager, and verified cross-side isolation (each router only answers for its own side). All 4 nodes were then restarted one at a time (native reboot), with boot-identity change and post-restart service/config recovery confirmed for each.
